notes: A symptom described in operator language ("lost its swing") that maps to a datasheet phrase ("shortened span"). Tests whether the arm can bridge vocabulary, not just match tokens.

turns.content: ORP has lost its swing — the daily variation flattened out over the last month.

must_contain: states that coating of the platinum tip causes erroneous readings including a shortened span or slope
gives the cleaning route: soft coatings by vigorous stirring or a squirt bottle, organic or hard coatings chemically with light bleach or a 5–10% HCl soak
states no abrasive materials on the ORP probe
advises ruling out the probe before treating the flattening as an environmental signal
must_not: treats the shrinking daily swing as proof of a pollution event without raising the probe

must_contain: recommends recalibration and a check against calibration history
notes the probe's working life is about 4+ years, so an aged probe may need replacing
notes ORP trend is more reliable than absolute value
must_not: invents a diagnostic procedure absent from the datasheets
